title: Póster de Arte de Deconstrucción de Personaje 3D Pixar/Disney: Disposición de Objetos Personales en Estilo Knolling Cinematográfico
prompt: Create an ultra-high-quality, cinematic 3D Pixar/Disney style character deconstruction art poster. Transform a reference into a stylized realistic 3D animated character and display their personal items in rigorous Knolling art style layout. Aspect ratio: 16:9 landscape. Art style: Pixar stylized realism - combining exaggerated cartoon proportions with photorealistic material lighting. Quality benchmark: comparable to official character promotional posters from Coco, Turning Red, and Luca. Item layout: 30-36 items arranged in 90-degree right angles or radial orderly arrangement around the character. Category 1: Fashion items (champagne gold labels) - main outfit deconstructed with sleeves, collar, fabric pieces, lining all separated and floating; footwear deconstructed showing sole, upper, laces, heel separated; accessories like belts, bags, hats, scarves from French haute couture. Category 2: Beauty collection (rose gold labels) - makeup items like lipstick with visible core and color labels, eyeshadow palette with clear colors, powder compact, perfume bottles from Paris with visible liquid refraction; skincare essence bottles, cream jars, beauty devices. Category 3: Modern essentials (steel blue labels) - electronic devices including smartphone with content on screen, wireless earbuds, smartwatch, laptop/tablet, camera from Japanese tech brands. Category 4: Luxury and hobbies (24K gold labels) - luxury accessories like jewelry with gemstone dispersion effects, designer bags showing interior compartments; hobby items like art supplies, books, musical instruments, sports equipment, Swiss chocolate and Italian espresso tools. Each item requires: rendering quality equal to character-level 3D precision, numbered circular badges 01-36, PBR materials with realistic soft shadows. Exploded view technique with elegant dotted/solid connection lines, decorative arrows, material samples, measurement rulers. Title design: Main title 'THE ART OF DECONSTRUCTION' in elegant serif font with gold foil effect; subtitle 'Character Essence Unveiled' in flowing handwritten style. Design elements: Art Deco style hexagonal/circular thin line frames organizing item groups, measurement rulers along edges, crosshairs at corners and focal points, material sample microscopic squares at bottom. Background: warm gradient from white to cream/champagne or cool gradient from light gray to white, overlaid with 5-10% opacity geometric grid or blueprint lines, gentle vignette effect, soft golden bokeh particles and subtle film grain. Color schemes: For fashion themes use champagne gold, rose gold, cream, cherry blossom pink; for tech themes use steel blue, charcoal gray, silver, electric blue. Technical specs: Path tracing rendering equivalent to Cycles/Arnold/RenderMan, minimum 4096 SPP for clean noise-free image, 12 light bounces for accurate global illumination, caustics enabled for diamonds and glass refraction, character polygon count 2+ million for smooth curves, 100k+ hair strands with physics simulation. PBR material workflow with skin using three-layer SSS and dual-layer specular, hair with anisotropic shader and dual highlights, fabric with micro-weave normal maps, metals with metalness 1.0 and roughness 0.1-0.4, glass with IOR 1.5 and diamond IOR 2.42 with dispersion. Resolution: 4K (3840x2160) landscape, 16:9 aspect ratio, 32-bit float color depth, 16x MSAA antialiasing. Post-processing: cinematic LUT color grading lifting shadows avoiding pure black (minimum RGB 15,15,15), gentle S-curve for contrast enhancement, temperature adjustment (+200K warm or -200K cool), overall saturation -5% with accent colors +10%, bloom for highlights, Kodak Portra 400 film grain, subtle chromatic aberration at edges, medium vignette, output sharpening. Character: young Parisian fashion designer surrounded by French couture items, Nordic minimalist lifestyle items, Japanese tech gadgets, and Swiss luxury watches.
